summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD joint press release on New Residential Construction for August 2022, issued September 20, 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 3a provides the Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) for Total Housing Starts and Single-Family Housing Starts for the United States, specifically covering the July (revised) and August (preliminary) 2022 data points required to establish the starting trend within the 2022/08–2025/05 range. The document lists August 2022 Total SAAR at 1,575,000 and Single-Family at 935,000; July 2022 Total at 1,404,000 and Single-Family at 904,000. These figures support the calculation of seasonally adjusted multifamily starts (Total minus Single-Family) and month-over-month trend direction for August 2022. As the initial release for August, the data is marked preliminary and may be superseded by later reports in the collection per the task's precedence rules.
